subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public cron, Gateway, UI, hook, QA Lab, and plugin SDK status, or should yielded-parent waiting remain internal until the eventual existing terminal status is recorded?
rationale: The bug fix can remain internal, but this branch additionally expands persisted and public API semantics; automation cannot choose that long-term compatibility contract safely.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Represent yielded-parent waiting in task/session lifecycle state and persist only the eventual existing terminal cron result.

options.title: Adopt public deferred
options.body: Accept `deferred` as a permanent status with explicit fresh-install, upgrade, SDK, CLI, automation, and final-settlement semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep waiting internal
recommendation.body: Represent yielded-parent waiting in task/session lifecycle state and persist only the eventual existing terminal cron result.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical yielded-run pause behavior traces to this owner, making them the strongest available decision owner for whether that internal lifecycle should become a public status contract.
